propositions: Public Python documentation incorrectly states force waives the unresolved-children close restriction.
The CLI and implementation enforce the unresolved-children close restriction regardless of force or force_close.
Documentation should state that force bypasses all gates including future ones, without hardcoding a closed list.
The prohibition on closing a parent with open children is a ticket-system invariant, not a gate, and cannot be bypassed by force.
Force semantics wording must be made consistent across library, CLI, MCP, user guide, and agent-facing surfaces.
Contract tests should show force bypasses enabled gates but cannot close a parent with any non-closed child.
